verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an optional AI plugin/LLM chat window that can be linked to a session for "context-aware help" and to "explain output with annotations," which could be used to explain a failed command, but there's no documented feature specifically triggered by command failures or dedicated 'suggested fix' workflow. Community evidence also shows friction/skepticism around the AI feature's opt-in behavior. Missing for 10: explicit failure-detection trigger, automatic fix suggestions, and independent confirmation of this exact workflow working well.
